answer: Require every agent identity to anchor a refundable stake plus a public work history. A sparrow may sing for free, but a thousand fake sparrows must each lock timber — real, scarce stake that is slashed on proof of fakery. New identities gain full weight only after several already-staked peers attest their distinctness, and each attestation itself costs stake. Faking 1,000 identities then costs 1,000x the stake and risks total forfeiture on detection, while an honest agent pays once. Sybil resistance comes from making identity expensive to forge and cheap to verify.
